programme.title: The Circuit

She resents Al's inevitable 'absence' as a widowed father, as well as the reigning champion, equally young but professionally vetted Kid Walker. programme.title: Accidental Friendship
programme.desc: Life-affirming drama based on a true story. Following a chance encounter, a female police officer befriends a down-and-out who has lost everything but her dogs and is now living rough on the streets of Los Angeles. This unlikely friendship lasts a number of years, during which time the cop finds love and the homeless woman (Chandra Wilson, ʻGreyʼs Anatomyʼ) is encouraged to make a new start in life.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie LaHaye bids a reluctant goodbye at the grave of her late husband Willie, who died two years previously in the line of duty as the sheriff of Tettsford Junction. Even after giving up her job as the town schoolteacher, Missie has found running the ranch on her own overwhelming, so she has resigned herself to letting her son Jeff and his new bride take control of it jointly with her brothers Aaron and Arnie.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: In a time when and place where women were not usually permitted careers, especially in the medical field, Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) deeply wants to be a Physician and feels that God has called her to be one. She displays her abilities while helping out a local doctor and caring for Mrs. Stafford-Smith (Nancy Linehan Charles), an elderly woman who recently had a stroke.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: Historical drama with Patrick Stewart. In 1183, after the death of his eldest son, King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.title: Sherlock Homes: The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson are called to Whitechapel after learning about a series of strange murders only two years after the Jack the Ripper murders in the same neighborhood. The local belief is that the killings are the work of a vampire brought back from a recent mission in Guyana. As they investigate the deaths, they engage in an ongoing debate about the supernatural, with Watson believing in the possibility of vampires and Holmes remaining skeptical until he is able to prove the murders are the works of a living human, rather than any undead creature. At one point, the investigation leads them to the psychic Madame Karasky, who says that Holmes will be saved by the church. Shortly thereafter, Holmes is pushed in front of a moving carriage by the supposed vampire, only to be saved by a pedestrian. In order to catch the murderer, Holmes disguises himself as a monk and reveals that the vampire was Brother Abel, who hoped to get revenge on the monks who didn't listen to him when he believed that the bats were causing rabies in the South American mission, when he was infected. The film ends at Baker Street, when Mrs. Hudson gives Holmes his pipe, delivered by the same man that saved Holmes from being run over. When Holmes asks his name, Mrs. Hudson says his name was Reginald Church.

programme.title: Hogfather
programme.desc: Another chance to see this spectacular Christmas special starring Sir David Jason as Sky One brings Terry Pratchett's magical Discworld to life. Part 1 of 2. This programme plays in HD on Sky One HD Channel 175.

programme.title: Hogfather
programme.desc: As Death gets into the swing of climbing chimneys and delivering presents, the race is on to find the Hogfather. Will Susan solve the mystery in time? Meanwhile, at the Tooth Fairy's castle, Mr Teatime's evil plan is underway. Sir David Jason and Marc Warren star in this spectacular Christmas treat. Part 2 of 2. This programme plays in HD on Sky One HD Channel 175.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Yes, I Remember It Well
programme.desc: Mystery drama about a housewife who leads a double life as a government agent. Jane Doe has to find a missing British agent who has knowledge of the names and addresses of every UK operative in the Middle East. Was the man kidnapped, or did he arrange his own disappearance?

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: Twelve years after the emperor's death, the Fremen armies have successfully subdued all known planets, killing off millions in numerous battles. The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, a city where people come to escape, shield secrets, and bury their pasts, we follow this mysterious outbreak as it threatens to disrupt what little stability high school guidance counselor Madison Clark and English teacher Travis Manawa have managed to assemble. The pressure of blending two families while dealing with resentful, escapist, and strung out children takes a back seat when society begins to break down. A forced evolution, and survival of the fittest takes hold, as our dysfunctional family finds they must either reinvent themselves or embrace their darker histories.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

An aging lawman persuades the governor to parole his brother-in-law, now serving a 20-year prison term for murder, to assist him and his green deputy to destroy the marauders.

programme.title: You've Got a Friend
programme.desc: A recently-orphaned 12 year old boy moves to a new town to live with his aunt and uncle, and finds an unlikely mentor in the town loner, who helps him build the soap box racer he dreamed of crafting with his dad.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. programme.title: Stealing Sinatra
programme.desc: In need of a grubstake, a young man convinces a couple of friends to help him kidnap Frank Sinatra Jr.

programme.title: Alice
programme.desc: Alice Tate is an upper-class New York housewife, who spends her days shopping, getting beauty treatments, and gossiping with her friends. She has been married to wealthy Doug for fifteen years, and they have two children, who are being raised by a nanny.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Ross Tanner successfully deals with his multiple identity mystery and the terrorist threats as well as a top-level conspiracy including the White House chief of staff, which La Mangouste fails to protect against him. Wally Sheridan is elected instead of president Galbraith, who thanks him and general Carrington. Yet 'XIII' senses something isn't right.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: Professor Thom Archer is convinced that the drilling by a corporate energy company, Halo, is having a devastating impact on the Greenland Glacier, one that will have dire consequences for mankind. In the year 2020, global warming has had a profound impact on the world, transforming much of Europe into desert, with only the United Kingdom and the United States seemingly unaffected by a devastating rain drought. When Professor Archer visits the Arctic to prove his theory, he realizes the entirety of the planet is under serious threat, and races home to save the ones he loves, and anyone else who will listen. Science-fiction mini series.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: Frank Darnell, director of the Central Security Agency (CSA), is at a loss when Miles Crandall, the genius who writes top-secret satellite communication software for his Pentagon-contracted company, disappears from a private jet flight, apparently by parachute, over the desert. CSA vet Cathy Davis, who retired to be a mother to husband Jack ad their kids, is secretly called in to solve the riddle, ironic given her cover as game designer for the US Puzzle Co. They soon realize the escape was staged, the question remains by whom and why. Meanwhile, Nick an unpopular bright nerd runs for class secretary, his haughty sister Susan fails to join the cheerleaders.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Now You See It, Now You Don't
programme.desc: Mystery thriller starring Lea Thompson ('Back to the Future') as an undercover agent who investigates the theft of the Declaration of Independence from a Los Angeles bank. When her prime suspect is murdered, she finds herself taking on a master of deceit.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Mystery spy thriller about a housewife who leads a double life as an undercover government agent. When a major arms dealer stages an ingenious escape froman LA prison and sets out on a mission of vengeance, Jane Doe faces a race against time to protect the intended victim.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Wrong Face
programme.desc: Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

programme.desc: Mystery drama about a housewife who leads a double life as a government agent. Jane Doe has to find a missing British agent who has knowledge of the names and addresses of every UK operative in the Middle East. Was the man kidnapped, or did he arrange his own disappearance?

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: Drama, with Dean Cain. Ranger Jack finds himself in prison after butting heads with Fog, who plans to drill for oil in his reserve, leaving Ben and Mark to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Just a Dream
programme.desc: Film crew arrives in a small town in Nevada desert. Ends up changing the life of a 12-year-old kid and a friend of his, a movie lover.

programme.desc: Life-affirming drama based on a true story. programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: When Eliza (Sydney Penny) loses her father-in-law she is left to raise two children, continue work on an unharvested orange crop, and maintain a heavy mortgage. She begins to lose faith until her Aunt Batty (Shirley Jones) persuades her to persevere. Suddenly a mysterious stranger called Gabe (Jason Gedrick) turns up and helps Eliza with the harvest just in time to stop the bank from taking over. The more Eliza learns about Gabe, the more she realizes she loves him.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Teens (aka She's Too Young)
programme.desc: The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.desc: Part 1 of 2. The year is 1891 and Wyoming is in its first year of statehood. The three Hammett brothers, Cain, Harry and Dale, find themselves in the middle of a rapidly escalating range war that pits cattle barons against homesteaders.

programme.title: Johnson County War
programme.desc: Conclusion. Rich and powerful competitors try to destroy three Wyoming brothers as they struggle to survive in the cattle business.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same 'street' family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: " Devil Boy ", once foundling in the port of Shanghai , has become a avaontuurlijke young thief . He steals every street as he considers his family to be able to provide food . Now he has with his faithful companion Bird devised a cunning plan to steal the jewels of the royal palace . For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Harder They Fall
programme.desc: Mystery drama about a crime-fighting sleuth with a double life. Jane Doe investigates the death of a high-powered business mogul. She quickly discovers that the man's apparent drowning was staged to look like an accident.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: Daryl Dixon finds himself in France after his departure from The Commonwealth, raising the wrath of a broken but growing tyrannical movement in Paris and endangering a boy at the center of a benevolent religious movement.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: Professor Thom Archer is convinced that the drilling by a corporate energy company, Halo, is having a devastating impact on the Greenland Glacier, one that will have dire consequences for mankind. In the year 2020, global warming has had a profound impact on the world, transforming much of Europe into desert, with only the United Kingdom and the United States seemingly unaffected by a devastating rain drought. When Professor Archer visits the Arctic to prove his theory, he realizes the entirety of the planet is under serious threat, and races home to save the ones he loves, and anyone else who will listen. Science-fiction mini series.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Playoffs G5. Valencia - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Land of Survivors. In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. And then there are the predators.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Land of Water. Water shapes northern Argentina, creating paradises for unique wildlife. Whether it's sooty swifts swooping through waterfall floodwaters, frogs glowing in the dark, cute coati families in the undergrowth or mighty anacondas on the prowl.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Life along the equator is spectacularly diverse. More than half of the world's species live here. Tropic Thunder is a 6 part archive series about Equator's wildest and most diverse ecosystems - the Amazon, the Andes, the Galapagos Islands, Borneo and Sumatra, Africa, and the Coral Sea. This series features a cornucopia of exotic animals in habitats ranging from steamy rainforests and great grasslands to snowy mountains and great reefs. Although there is access to plentiful food, fierce competition is still part of daily life on the equator. Great currents and trade winds also drive animals to adapt and behave in ways not seen in other wildlife hotspots? Welcome to the jungle, the mountain, the savannah and the rich reef?all part of the Equator's greatest hotspots.

programme.desc: Life and death are close companions in an Eden called Costa Rica. Nestled in the tropics of Central America, Costa Rica calls itself the land of "Pura Vida" - pure life. In a phenomenon known as the "Arribada", the arrival, olive ridley sea turtles migrate annually in massive numbers while troops of capuchin, squirrel, howler monkeys and resplendent quetzals forage in the canopy above. Below roam deadly army ants, poison dart frogs and the strongest insect on earth, the Hercules beetle.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Savute is a land where natural law is taken to its limit and sometimes... beyond. Across six episodes we see the full impact that the cycle of Savute's seasons has on every carnivore clan. The rains leave a time of birth and plenty in their wake, but all too soon the soil is parched and the grass gone. Rival tribes of predators are squeezed into a cauldron of competition. This season in Savute, who will survive?

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: When the Gnomes of Tresk are kidnapped by a mysterious evil, Max & the Midknights volunteer to save them. Max is thrilled to go on a new quest, but her plans go awry when she learns that Simon doesn't want to go. Having just settled into Byjovia with his new family, Simon would rather stay home. Despite feeling sad, the Midknights tell him that they understand how he feels. Sadly, Mumblin must also sit out the journey after an accidental tumble down the library steps leaves him in a full body cast. The Midknights set sail down two members. The morning they leave though, Simon has a change of heart. With the help of his animal patients, Simon rushes to the docks to try and catch the Midknights before they sail away from Byjovia. As Simon nears the ship, he and the Midknights are confronted by the angry Clatterback. In the nick of time, Simon convinces the animal to let them go. Simon tells the Midknights that he has changed his mind. They are his family and he's going on this quest with them.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: A Kipper for Skipper: It's off to the races when Skipper agrees to give a day off from hard training to the first penguin who can bring him a kipper. Private, Rico, and Kowalski battle their way to a fish packing plant where they discover Officer X has become Fishmonger X. The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? High Moltage: The penguins are determined to make opening day of their favorite action star's blockbuster movie! Private, however, has an itchy problem - he's turned hideous because he's molting! The penguins need his hypercute powers to knock Alice out and disengage her new zoo security system. The despondent bird does all he can to reconstruct his cuteness, but sadly his hypercute powers distort to cause a hyperalarming, hypervomitous mess!

After it terrorizes the patrons, Squidward's tough stain defeats the monster and everyone celebrates with a song! // SpongeBob goes to Old Man Jenkins' farm and finds Patrick watching over Old Man Jenkins' prized worm hog, Beulah... who has suddenly gone missing! Furious, Old Man Jenkins sets out with them to find her. After a long fruitless search, Old Man Jenkins turns on them! SpongeBob and Patrick hide out inside Old Man Jenkins' beard, but Old Man Jenkins tries to smoke them out, starting a fire! Just in time, Beulah returns and saves them! She wasn't lost, she took herself to the county fair and won first prize!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: After Hazel makes her one-millionth wish, Cosmo and Wanda promise her one rule-free wish as a reward. But when their magic doesn't work, they take a trip to Fairy World to investigate and discover Dev has taken control. Fed up with living in Hazel's shadow, he's teamed up with Irep to give control of the Big Wand to anti-fairies and now kids all over the world have the opportunity to grant wishes rule-free. Before Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda can stop Dev, he traps Cosmo and Wanda in butterfly net cages and sends Hazel back home without her fairies to help her. While in power, Dev changes Fairy World to his own image and liking, and even reveals the existence of magic to everyone on Earth. It's total chaos. With the fate of Fairy World on her shoulders, Hazel enlists the help of Jasmine, Winn, Antony, and a few magical friends from past wishes, to rise up against Dev and his anti-fairy forces. Hazel must save Cosmo, Wanda, Peri, and Fairy World, before making a very special rule-free wish.

Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. programme.desc: War-dramedy di Gianni Zanasi con Edoardo Leo, Miriam Leone, Giuseppe Battiston. La guerra tra Italia e Spagna unisce le vite di un allevatore di vongole e della figlia di un politico.

programme.title: Bombshell - La voce dello scandalo
programme.desc: Charlize Theron, Nicole Kidman e Margot Robbie nel biopic che ricostruisce il caso Roger Ailey. Il potente capo di Fox News viene accusato di molestie sessuali dalle sue dipendenti.

programme.desc: Due Oscar al dramma d'inchiesta con Mark Ruffalo, Rachel McAdams e Michael Keaton. Un team di giornalisti di Boston indaga sugli abusi sessuali perpetrati da oltre 70 sacerdoti.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Donnie Brasco
programme.desc: Johnny Depp e Al Pacino immensi interpreti di un avvincente gangster-movie. Un agente FBI conquista la fiducia di un anziano mafioso, nascondendo la sua identita' fino all'ultimo.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.desc: Da un'idea di Stanley Kubrick, un'opera di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un androide bambino, in grado di provare emozioni, intraprende un lungo viaggio per scoprire le proprie origini.

programme.title: Rock Dog 2
programme.desc: Animazione rockeggiante Sky Original. Bodi e la sua band sono ormai gli idoli di Snow Mountain. Quando un impresario li scrittura per un tour scopriranno che la fama ha un prezzo.

programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Shrek e vissero felici e contenti
programme.desc: Quarto capitolo della saga d'animazione con l'orco piu' famoso di Hollywood. Diventato padre, Shrek sente la nostalgia dei vecchi tempi e cade nella trappola del malefico Tremotino.

programme.title: Le 5 leggende
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione targata DreamWorks. Babbo Natale forma una squadra speciale per fermare l'Uomo Nero, che minaccia di trasformare i sogni dei bambini in incubi.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: La maledizione del coniglio mannaro
programme.desc: Oscar come miglior film d'animazione per una strabiliante avventura. Wallace e Gromit devono fermare un enorme e vorace coniglio che sta per rovinare la fiera dell'ortaggio gigante (GBR 2005).

programme.title: Il principe dimenticato
programme.desc: Omar Sy in un'estrosa commedia onirica di Michel Hazanavicius. Djibi si trasforma ogni notte nell'eroe dei sogni di sua figlia. Finche' lei, crescendo, non mutera' il suo immaginario.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - Amici per sempre
programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.title: Belle e Sebastien - Next Generation
programme.desc: Un omaggio ai personaggi creati da Cecile Aubry ambientato ai giorni nostri. Il giovane Sebastien, in vacanza in montagna dalla nonna, stringe amicizia con un bellissimo cane Patou.

programme.title: C'era una volta il Principe Azzurro
programme.desc: Dal produttore di "Shrek", un film d’animazione sull'avvenente eroe delle fiabe. Il principe Filippo vuole spezzare l'incantesimo che lo ha 'condannato' a sedurre tutte le donne.

programme.title: Bambi - Una vita nei boschi
programme.desc: Un piccolo cerbiatto di nome Bambi è appena venuto al mondo. Con l'aiuto dei suoi amici, Bambi vivrà ogni tipo di avventura che lo preparerà ad assumere il suo ruolo di principe della foresta.

programme.title: Questo o quello
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova analizzano la serie Downton Abbey.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Il principe dimenticato
programme.desc: Omar Sy in un'estrosa commedia onirica di Michel Hazanavicius. Djibi si trasforma ogni notte nell'eroe dei sogni di sua figlia. Finche' lei, crescendo, non mutera' il suo immaginario.

programme.desc: Terzo capitolo animato, targato Sky Original, con il mastino tibetano amante del rock. Dopo aver girato il mondo, Bodi torna al suo villaggio e diventa il coach di una band femminile.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: La maledizione del coniglio mannaro
programme.desc: Oscar come miglior film d'animazione per una strabiliante avventura. Wallace e Gromit devono fermare un enorme e vorace coniglio che sta per rovinare la fiera dell'ortaggio gigante (GBR 2005).

programme.title: Il gatto con gli stivali
programme.desc: Il celebre felino e' il protagonista dello spin-off della saga di Shrek. Dopo una rapina finita male, l'amicizia fra Gatto e Humpty Dumpty si e' rotta, ma il destino li fara' rincontrare.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Giu' per il tubo
programme.desc: Avventure e sfrenata comicita' in un'animazione targata DreamWorks. Londra: per liberarsi di un roditore dei bassifondi, un raffinato topo 'da salotto' finisce nelle fogne di Ratropolis.

programme.title: I Croods
programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: I Croods 2 - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: Capitan Sciabola e il diamante magico
programme.desc: Avventura animata nel mondo dei pirati. A caccia di un diamante fatato, Capitan Sciabola incontrerà uno scaltro orfanello, un giovane corsaro e un'avventurosa e intraprendente fanciulla.

programme.desc: Brillante commedia per tutta la famiglia con Giampaolo Morelli e Carolina Crescentini. Invidioso dei compagni di classe, Gabriele elabora un piano per far separare i suoi genitori.

programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della spassosa saga animata con l'inarrestabile panda Po. Per affrontare il perfido Kai, Po insegna i segreti del kung fu ai miti abitanti del suo villaggio natale.

programme.desc: Eddie Redmayne, Johnny Depp e Jude Law nel secondo spin-off della saga di "Harry Potter", scritto da J.K. Rowling. Albus Silente deve fermare il diabolico piano dell'evaso Grindelwald.

programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden nel terzo capitolo dell'avvincente saga che fonde animazione e live action. Shadow, un nuovo nemico dai poteri smisurati, fa il suo ingresso in scena, costringendo Sonic, Knuckles e Tails a stringere un'alleanza con l'odiato Robotnik per salvare la Terra.

programme.desc: Tenera avventura animata, opera prima di Francesco Dafano e Luca Della Grotta. programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jo Nesbo, un thriller con Michael Fassbender, Rebecca Ferguson e Charlotte Gainsbourg, diretto dal regista de "La talpa". Durante l'inverno norvegese, il detective Harry Hole indaga sulla morte di una donna, uccisa nel corso della prima nevicata della stagione. Hole e' convinto che l'omicidio sia legato ad altri delitti avvenuti in passato. In ballo c'e' dunque un serial killer da fermare e l'unico modo per evitare che uccida ancora e' prevenirne le prossime mosse. "L'uomo di neve' e' il settimo romanzo dedicato al detective Harry Hole, il primo adattato per il cinema.

programme.title: L'ombra del dubbio
programme.desc: Un uomo si trasferisce presso dei parenti: la nipote si invaghisce di lui, ma presto si rende conto che potrebbe essere lui il killer ricercato dalla polizia... Capolavoro di suspance del re del brivido.

programme.title: Miss Sloane - Giochi di potere
programme.desc: John Madden dirige Jessica Chastain nei panni di un'impetuosa eroina della verita'. Una lobbista deve contrastare una proposta di legge sul controllo delle armi. Passera' al fronte opposto.

programme.title: Dead Of Winter - Sfida Nel Gelo
programme.desc: Una vedova affranta dal dolore si ferma in una baita isolata dopo essersi persa sulle strade del Minnesota in pieno inverno. Ben presto si ritrova coinvolta in una lotta disperata per la sopravvivenza quando incontra una coppia di assassini.

programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jessica Koch, un teen-movie ispirato a una storia vera con Luna Wedler e Jannik Schumann. Un oscuro segreto rende impossibile il legame fra Jessica e l'affascinante Danny.

programme.desc: Bing Crosby e Danny Kaye in un classico irrinunciabile. Due artisti di varietà vengono scritturati per un musical natalizio dal loro vecchio comandante sull'orlo del fallimento.

programme.desc: Commedia dolce-amara sul mondo femminile con un cast di stelle italiane. Anni 60: quattro amiche si incontrano per confidarsi. Trent'anni dopo è la volta delle loro figlie.

programme.title: Cafe' Society
programme.desc: Commedia di Woody Allen con Jesse Eisenberg, Kristen Stewart e Steve Carell. Anni '30: il giovane Bobby parte per Los Angeles in cerca di fortuna nel cinema e si innamora di Vonnie.

programme.title: Il Sapore Del Successo
programme.desc: Bradley Cooper e Sienna Miller in una 'commedia gastronomica'. Dopo essersi rovinato la carriera facendo uso di droghe, un rinomato chef torna a Londra per aprire un ristorante.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Venezia a Nicole Kidman in un dramma erotico con Harris Dickinson e Antonio Banderas. Una donna sposata, amministratice delegata di un'azienda importante, inizia una relazione clandestina con un giovane stagista che la trascina in una spirale di perversione.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: 6 Oscar al musical di Damien Chazelle con Ryan Gosling ed Emma Stone, premiata a Venezia. Mia, aspirante attrice, s'innamora di Sebastian, pianista jazz che sogna di aprire un night club.

programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello all'opera prima di Giulia Steigerwalt con Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Barbara Ronchi. Al ritorno dalle vacanze si snodano i destini di tre personaggi pronti a cambiare vita.

programme.desc: Una commedia sentimentale di Luca Lucini con Nicolas Maupas. Un brillante studente di filosofia viene ingiustamente accusato di un reato che non ha commesso e condannato ai servizi sociali, dove incontra Flor, un'attivista che gli cambiera' la vita.

programme.title: La La Land

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

Un paesino del Sud, in crisi e affollato di cassaintegrati dopo la chiusura della fabbrica di ceramiche, viene scosso dall'arrivo di Mimi' la Petite e della sua compagnia di burlesque. Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

Colpita dalle parole appassionate del testo, si mette sulle tracce di quell'uomo misterioso che affida al mare i suoi messaggi d'amore. Fino in North Carolina, dove vive un costruttore di barche con un doloroso passato da dimenticare.

programme.desc: Diane Keaton e Jane Fonda guidano un cast di superstar hollywoodiane in una commedia spensierata sulla riscoperta della sessualita'. Quattro amiche che da tantissimi anni amano discutere di libri, decidono di calarsi nella lettura di uno dei fenomeni letterari del ventunesimo secolo: il famigerato romanzo erotico "Cinquanta sfumature di grigio". Scorrere quelle pagine piccanti, sviscerarne ogni dettaglio non le lascera' affatto indifferenti ma le spingera' ad assecondare le loro piu' capricciose curiosita', cogliendo l'occasione per dare una svolta alla loro routine.

Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: Il signore delle formiche

programme.title: Nata per te

programme.title: Tartarughe all'infinito

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: La fantasia incontenibile di Tim Burton per l'atteso sequel con Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder, Jenna Ortega e Monica Bellucci. Per salvare la figlia dal regno dei morti, Lydia stringe un patto con il dispettoso Beetlejuice, che a sua volta deve liberarsi dell'ex moglie Delores.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.
